brief:
The Palestinian Investment Fund is implementing a strategic cement manufacturing facility in Jericho in partnership with Jordanian company Al-Ittihad Al-Khamsah, according to Maan Wire. The plant is approaching its production phase and is expected to bolster the domestic industrial sector while meeting a substantial portion of Palestinian market demand for cement.

The investment represents a joint Palestinian-Jordanian initiative designed to reduce reliance on imported cement and strengthen local supply chains across Palestinian territories. Officials view the facility as a critical step toward advancing national industry and ensuring stable access to essential construction materials for the Palestinian economy.
title: Jericho cement mill nears production to supply Palestinian market
